'''Xinsheng Sean Ling''' ({{zh|c=凌新生 |p=Líng Xīnshēng}}; born February 15, 1964) is a Chinese-American [[physicist]] and professor at [[Brown University]].<ref name="auto">{{cite web|title=Xinsheng Ling|url=https://vivo.brown.edu/display/xling|website=Brown University|access-date=28 March 2018}}</ref> He is known for his work in [[condensed matter physics|condensed matter]], in particular for his contributions to [[superconductivity]], [[vortex]] physics, [[colloid]] physics, [[biophysics]], and [[quantum physics]]. He joined the faculty of Brown University in 1996.<ref name="auto"/>

== Biography and career ==
Ling graduated from [[Wuhan University]] in 1984. He earned his M.S. from the [[University of Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 1987 and his Ph.D. from the [[University of Connecticut]] in 1992.<ref name="auto" />

He has done postdoctoral research at [[Yale University]] and the [[NEC Corporation of America|NEC Research Institute]]. In 1998 and 2002, he was named an [[Alfred P. Sloan]] Fellow and [[Guggenheim Fellowship|Guggenheim Fellow]] respectively. He has been a Fellow of the [[American Physical Society]] since 2005.<ref name="auto" /><ref>{{cite web |title=John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation Fellowships |url=https://www.brown.edu/about/administration/dean-of-faculty/faculty-awards-and-honors/john-simon-guggenheim-memorial-foundation-fellowships |publisher=Brown University}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=American Physical Society Fellows |url=https://www.brown.edu/about/administration/dean-of-faculty/faculty-awards-and-honors/american-physical-society-fellows |publisher=Brown University}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Sloan Research Fellows |url=https://sloan.org/past-fellows |publisher=Alfred P. Sloan Foundation |access-date=2019-07-05 |archive-date=2018-03-14 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180314000756/https://sloan.org/past-fellows |url-status=dead }}</ref> His research areas include quantum physics of matter, colloid physics, and nanobiophysics.<ref name="auto" /><ref>{{cite web |title=NABsys and Brown University Establish Strategic Partnership |url=https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20050809005712/en/NABsys-Brown-University-Establish-Strategic-Partnership-Brown |website=Business Wire|date=2005-08-09 }}</ref>
